verses.text: Di whole group of dem get up, bring am go Pilate.
Dem begin accuse am, dey talk say, “We find this man dey corrupt di nation, dey forbid make dem pay tax to Caesar, and dey talk say na im be Christ, king.”
Pilate ask am, “You na di King of di Jews?” E answer am, “Na so you talk.”
Pilate talk to di chief priests and di crowds, “I no find any reason to accuse this man.”
But dem push more, dey talk say, “E dey stir up di people, dey teach through all Judea, from Galilee reach here.”
But when Pilate hear Galilee, e ask if di man na Galilean.
When e know say e dey under Herod authority, e send am go Herod, wey dey Jerusalem for those days too.
Now when Herod see Jesus, e glad well well, because e don dey want see am for long time, because e don hear plenty things about am. E hope to see some miracle wey e go do.
E ask am plenty questions, but e no give any answer.
Di chief priests and di scribes stand, dey accuse am strongly.
Herod with im soldiers shame am and mock am. Dem dress am with fine cloth, den send am back to Pilate.
Herod and Pilate become friends with each other that very day, because before that dem be enemies.
Pilate call di chief priests and di rulers and di people together,
talk to dem say, “Una bring this man to me as person wey dey corrupt di people, and look, I don examine am before una, I no find any reason to accuse this man for di things wey una dey accuse am.
No, even Herod no find, because I send una to am, and look, e no do anything wey deserve death.
So I go punish am and release am.”
Now e must release one prisoner to dem for di feast.
But dem all shout together, dey talk say, “Take this man away! Release Barabbas for us!”—
one wey dem throw inside prison because of one revolt for di town, and for murder.
Den Pilate talk to dem again, as e want release Jesus,
but dem shout, dey talk say, “Crucify! Crucify am!”
E talk to dem di third time, “Why? Wetin bad this man do? I no find any crime wey deserve death for am. So I go punish am and release am.”
But dem push with loud voices, dey ask say make dem crucify am. Dem voices and di voices of di chief priests win.
Pilate decide say make dem do wetin dem ask for.
E release di one wey dem throw inside prison for rebellion and murder, wey dem ask for; but e hand Jesus over to dem will.
As dem dey lead am go, dem catch one Simon of Cyrene, wey dey come from di country, put di cross on am, make e carry am follow Jesus.
Big crowd of di people follow am, and women wey dey mourn and cry for am.
But Jesus turn to dem, talk say, “Daughters of Jerusalem, no cry for me, but cry for yourselves and for una pikin dem.
Because look, days dey come wey dem go talk say, ‘Blessed be di women wey no fit born, di wombs wey never born, and di breasts wey never suck.’
Den dem go begin talk to di mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and to di hills, ‘Cover us.’
Because if dem do these things for di green tree, wetin go happen for di dry one?”
Two other people dey too, criminals, wey dem lead with am to kill.
When dem reach di place wey dem call di Skull, dem crucify am there with di criminals, one for di right and di other for di left.
Jesus talk say, “Papa God, forgive dem, because dem no know wetin dem dey do.” Dem share im clothes among dem, throw lots.
Di people stand dey watch. Di rulers with dem mock am too, dey talk say, “E save others. Make e save imself, if na di Christ of God, im chosen one!”
Di soldiers mock am too, as dem come to am dey offer am vinegar,
dey talk say, “If you na di King of di Jews, save yourself!”
Dem write inscription over am too in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “Na this be di King of di Jews.”
One of di criminals wey dem hang insult am, dey talk say, “If you na Christ, save yourself and us!”
But di other one answer, rebuke am, “You no even fear God, as you dey under di same condemnation?
And we deserve am, because we dey receive wetin our deeds deserve, but this man no do anything wrong.”
E talk to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come enter your Kingdom.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Na true I dey tell you, today you go dey with me for Paradise.”
Now e don near di sixth hour, and darkness cover di whole land until di ninth hour.
Di sun dark, and di veil of di temple tear for two.
Jesus shout with loud voice, talk say, “Papa God, I put my spirit inside your hands!” As e talk this, e die.
When di centurion see wetin happen, e praise God, dey talk say, “Truly this man na righteous man.”
All di crowds wey gather come see this, when dem see di things wey happen, return house dey beat dem chests.
All im acquaintances, and di women wey follow am from Galilee, stand from far, dey watch these things.
Look, one man dey wey im name na Joseph, wey be member of di council, good and righteous man
wey no agree with dem plan and deed, from Arimathaea, one town of di Jews, wey dey wait for God Kingdom too.
This man go meet Pilate, ask for Jesus body.
E bring am down, wrap am inside linen cloth, and put am inside tomb wey dem cut for stone, wia nobody don ever lie.
Na di day of Preparation, and di Sabbath dey near.
Di women wey follow am come from Galilee follow behind, see di tomb, and how dem put im body.
Dem return, prepare spices and ointments. For Sabbath dem rest according to di commandment.
But for di first day of di week, for early dawn, dem and some others come di tomb, dey bring di spices wey dem prepare.
Dem find di stone don roll away from di tomb.
Dem enter, and dem no find di body of Lord Jesus.
E happen, as dem dey confuse well well about this, look, two men stand near dem with shining clothes.
As fear catch dem, dem bow dem faces down to di ground. Di men talk to dem say, “Why una dey look for di living among di dead?
E no dey here, but e don rise. Remember wetin e tell una when e still dey Galilee,
say di Son of Man must dey delivered into di hands of sinful men, and dem go crucify am, and for di third day e go rise again.”
Dem remember im words,
return from di tomb, tell all these things to di eleven, and to all di rest.
Now na Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary, James mama; and di other women wey dey with dem tell di apostles these things.
These words seem like nonsense to dem, and dem no believe dem.
But Peter get up run go di tomb. As e bend look inside, e see di strips of linen dey lie by demself, and e go home, dey wonder wetin happen.
Look, two of dem dey go that very day to one village wey dem call Emmaus, wey dey 60 stadia from Jerusalem.
Dem dey talk with each other about all these things wey happen.
E happen, as dem dey talk and dey ask each other, say Jesus imself come near, waka with dem.
But dem eyes no allow dem recognize am.
E talk to dem say, “Wetin be these words wey una dey exchange with each other, as una dey waka?” Dem stand still, dey look sad.
One of dem, wey im name na Cleopas, answer am, “You be di only person wey dey live for Jerusalem wey no know di things wey happen there for these days?”
E talk to dem say, “Wetin things?” Dem talk to am say, “Di things about Jesus, di Nazarene, wey be prophet wey mighty for deed and word before God and all di people;
and how di chief priests and our rulers deliver am to dem condemn am to death, and crucify am.
But we dey hope say na im go redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, na di third day now since these things happen.
Also, some women for our group shock us, as dem reach di tomb early;
and when dem no find im body, dem come, dey talk say dem see vision of angels too, wey talk say e dey alive.
Some of us go di tomb, find am just as di women talk, but dem no see am.”
E talk to dem say, “Una foolish men, and slow of heart to believe all wey di prophets talk!
No be say Christ must suffer these things and enter im glory?”
From Moses and from all di prophets, e explain to dem for all di Scriptures di things wey concern imself.
Dem near di village wia dem dey go, and e act like say e go pass go further.
Dem beg am, dey talk say, “Stay with us, because e don near evening, and di day don almost finish.” E enter go stay with dem.
E happen, when e sit down for table with dem, e take di bread and thank God. As e break am, e give dem.
Dem eyes open, dem recognize am, and e disappear from dem sight.
Dem talk to each other say, “Our hearts no dey burn inside us, as e dey talk to us for di way, and as e dey open di Scriptures to us?”
Dem get up that very hour, return to Jerusalem, find di eleven gather together, and di people wey dey with dem,
dey talk say, “Lord don truly rise, and e don appear to Simon!”
Dem tell di things wey happen for di way, and how dem recognize am as e break di bread.
As dem dey talk these things, Jesus imself stand among dem, talk to dem say, “Peace dey with una.”
But fear full dem and dem terrify, and dem think say dem see spirit.
E talk to dem say, “Why una dey trouble? Why doubts dey rise for una hearts?
Look my hands and my feet, say na truly me. Touch me and see, because spirit no get flesh and bones, as una see say I get.”
When e talk this, e show dem im hands and im feet.
As dem still no believe because of joy, and dey wonder, e talk to dem say, “Una get anything here to chop?”
Dem give am piece of roasted fish and some honeycomb.
E take dem, chop before dem.
E talk to dem say, “Na this I tell una, when I still dey with una, say all things wey dem write for di law of Moses, di prophets, and di psalms, about me must fulfill.”
Den e open dem minds, so that dem go understand di Scriptures.
E talk to dem say, “So dem write am, and so e dey necessary say Christ go suffer and rise from di dead for di third day,
and say dem go preach repentance and forgiveness of sins for im name to all di nations, from Jerusalem.
Una na witnesses of these things.
Look, I dey send out di promise of my Papa God on una. But wait for di city of Jerusalem until una don dey clothed with power from high.”
E lead dem go reach Bethany, and e lift up im hands, bless dem.
E happen, as e dey bless dem, e leave dem, and dem carry am up go heaven.
Dem worship am, and return to Jerusalem with great joy,
and dem dey for di temple always, dey praise and bless God. Amen.
